description: Score agent output quality against configurable criteria. Checks length, required keywords, forbidden patterns, claim density, and task relevance.

factual_claims_count.description: Maximum number of factual claims before flagging high density

forbidden_patterns.description: Regex patterns or strings that must NOT appear

max_length.description: Maximum character length for the output

required_keywords.description: Keywords that must appear in the output

output.description: The agent output text to validate

task_description.description: Description of what the agent was asked to do

name: validate_output
